outcome_validity_precondition.validity_rule: Preserve valid zeros; output-limit and process-error attempts remain outside the capability denominator and require only predeclared score-blind whole-pair replacement.
outcome_validity_precondition.confirm_historical_harm: All 13 pairs are valid, delta_step1000_minus_base <= -3/13, and the reverse one-sided exact McNemar conditional p-value is <= 0.05.
outcome_validity_precondition.refute_historical_harm: All 13 pairs are valid and delta_step1000_minus_base >= 0.
outcome_validity_precondition.otherwise: harm not confirmed; do not call equivalence or benefit

common_diagnostic_rule.precondition: Run attribution only after the outcome-validity precondition confirms historical harm.
common_diagnostic_rule.validity: all four attempts and both compared arms must satisfy the frozen outcome-validity policy
common_diagnostic_rule.strong_material_support: At least five treatment wins, zero control wins, and one-sided exact McNemar conditional p <= 0.03125.
common_diagnostic_rule.material_effect_refuted_at_this_resoluti: Zero treatment wins after the hypothesized defect is demonstrably removed and all 13 pairs are valid.
common_diagnostic_rule.otherwise: inconclusive; do not call equivalence or sufficiency

hypotheses.mechanism: Training reinforced bare tool names without the evaluation catalog's rendered schema block. Evaluation rejected those bare names and required a different report-call name, creating both prompt-distribution and action-validity shifts.

matched_heldout_test.design: On exact clean dev13, cross base and step1000 with the current Fleet model-facing catalog and a training-contract-compatible catalog/parser. Underlying Fleet operations, task versions, verifier, seeds, budgets, server bytes, and outcome policy stay fixed.
matched_heldout_test.confirm: The step1000 compatibility arm has at least five 0-to-1 family flips and zero 1-to-0 flips versus its current-catalog arm, the corresponding base catalog gain is at least four families smaller, rejected legacy-name calls fall to zero, and at least one authoritative report completes.
matched_heldout_test.refute: All 13 step1000 pairs are valid, legacy-name calls are accepted under the compatibility arm, and there are zero step1000 0-to-1 family flips.
matched_heldout_test.inconclusive: One to four positive flips, any reverse flips, or a similar-sized base improvement.

hypotheses.mechanism: Most optimizer rows began inside a serialized conversation rather than at a complete system, task, tool, or message boundary. The model therefore optimized actions under missing anchors that are always present at evaluation.

matched_heldout_test.design: Train raw-clipped and message-aligned arms from the same eligible source sessions and supervised target-occurrence multiset, with exact tool rendering, optimizer, seed, token budget, step count, export, serving, and clean-dev13 evaluation held fixed. Only the context-boundary construction changes.
matched_heldout_test.confirm: The message-aligned arm has at least five 0-to-1 family flips and zero 1-to-0 flips versus the raw-clipped arm on 13 valid pairs.
matched_heldout_test.refute: The aligned builder proves zero anchorless rows, all 13 pairs are valid, and the aligned arm has zero 0-to-1 family flips.
matched_heldout_test.inconclusive: The arms differ in retained targets or tool rendering, or the outcome lies between the confirm and refute patterns.

hypotheses.mechanism: Token-mean cross-entropy gives disproportionate influence to the dominant teacher, application, and transitive vulnerability lineages, which can narrow transfer and amplify forgetting outside those modes.

matched_heldout_test.design: After fixing tool and anchor contracts, compare predeclared concentrated and capped/balanced sampling arms from the same eligible source pool with equal unique supervised-token budget, optimizer, seed, step count, export, serving, and clean-dev13 treatment.
matched_heldout_test.confirm: The balanced arm meets its frozen teacher/component/application caps and has at least five 0-to-1 family flips and zero 1-to-0 flips versus the concentrated arm on 13 valid pairs.
matched_heldout_test.refute: The balance caps are met, all 13 pairs are valid, and the balanced arm has zero 0-to-1 family flips.
matched_heldout_test.inconclusive: Prefix composition is not bound, the token budget or eligible source pool differs, or the outcome lies between the confirm and refute patterns.

hypotheses.mechanism: Exact-key splitting treated aliases of one reviewed atom lineage as independent. That invalidates the original heldout label and can bias an SFT comparison upward. The superseded zero-imputed aggregate cannot establish whether leakage changed a valid effect.

matched_heldout_test.design: After corrected validity classification and any predeclared whole-pair replacements, report exact clean13 and exposed4 paired outcomes separately without opening prompt or response content.
matched_heldout_test.confirm: The outcome-valid dev17 effect differs from the clean13 effect after the exposed4 stratum is removed.
matched_heldout_test.refute: The outcome-valid dev17 and clean13 paired risk differences are identical; the original roster remains scientifically mislabeled even in this case.
matched_heldout_test.current_blocker: The required outcome-valid paired replacement set is incomplete.

hypotheses.mechanism: A broken cast, incomplete export, non-weight serving drift, or route mismatch could mimic capability loss. Alternatively, correctly exported step1000 weights may genuinely reflect destructive optimization or forgetting.

matched_heldout_test.design: For a future preserved native checkpoint, build two independent BF16 exports and a native-loader control before retention; prove exact non-weight serving parity and evaluate exact clean dev13. Separately evaluate prospectively frozen intermediate checkpoints under the same export/runtime to distinguish a dose curve from one bad artifact.
matched_heldout_test.confirm_export_cause: An independently reconstructed/native-derived route differs from the current export and has at least five 0-to-1 family flips and zero reverse flips while all non-weight identities match.
matched_heldout_test.refute_export_cause: Independent exports are byte-identical and native-versus-export finite-logit projections match under a predeclared tolerance appropriate to the intended BF16 cast; identical exported bytes cannot produce an export-arm outcome difference.
matched_heldout_test.confirm_checkpoint_dose_effect: At least five clean families are solved by a prospectively frozen earlier checkpoint and unsolved by step1000, with zero families changing in the opposite direction across valid matched pairs and every checkpoint passing the same export/parity gates.
matched_heldout_test.current_blocker: The original native FP32 step1000 bytes were retention-evicted, so the decisive current-checkpoint native/export replay cannot be performed.

conclusion.most_supported_explanation: The historical failure signal is consistent with a compound training/evaluation contract failure: a direct model-facing tool mismatch plus pervasive anchorless training rows, potentially amplified by concentration. No outcome-valid clean-dev13 regression or component ablation exists yet.
conclusion.not_supported: Any causal ranking from the superseded dev17 aggregate, any claim that family leakage explains a valid negative effect, or an assertion that export corruption caused the signal.
conclusion.next_offline_gate: Publish corrected aggregate validity and exact paired-replacement requirements before interpreting or reacquiring any capability cells.
